label: Occupational-therapy series (Hospital Billing)
note: The single real Hospital-Billing episode: three occupational-therapy charges in March 2022 totaling $1,638.82. Blue Cross wrote off $1,084.55 (above the allowed amount + bundled) and applied the entire $554.27 allowed amount to the patient's deductible — so insurance paid $0 and the patient's true out-of-pocket here was $554.27. The account closed at $0 on May 11, 2022.
emptyShellsNote: Three other hospital-account shells exist with no transactions at all — a common Epic artifact, not real episodes of care.
